A month later, we tap Stone Beer at our annual Festival of the Stone – our biggest beer and music festival of the year where our community comes together to enjoy fresh beer, live music, food trucks and winter cheer.

AdditionalDetails.Value:
Delirium Tremens, the charismatic legend of Belgian Blond Ales, also known as "The Pink Elephant Beer," invites you into a whimsical world where flavors mingle and bubbles dance.
Behold its golden glow and luscious white head, with a sweet, biscuit malt backbone supported by pleasant warmth and spice. The finish is well-rounded, floral, and dry. This blond ale sparkles with fine, regular effervescence and has a slightly malty scent with a touch of alcohol and spice on the nose.
With a robust 8.5% ABV, Delirium Tremens is ideal for moments that call for a bold, distinctive beer. Perfect for celebrating special occasions or enjoying a leisurely evening, it pairs beautifully with rich, hearty dishes and makes any gathering more memorable.
